common_gotchas: The cook callback runs every time the Script DAT cooks, so output-building code must clear and refill intentionally.
Script DAT can access arbitrary project state; TouchDesigner tracks dependencies dynamically and resets that dependency list when the toe restarts.
Hidden dependencies can make generated Script DATs recook when unrelated referenced operators or parameters change.
Use Script DAT when procedural table construction is needed; simpler Evaluate, Substitute, Insert, Sort, or Reorder DATs are safer for basic transforms.
key_concepts: Generates DAT contents from Python callback code.
Callbacks DAT defines the cook/generation logic for table or text output.
Setup Parameters can create custom parameters used by the script generator.
Common DAT extension and language controls affect editing and script interpretation.
